name: VR prioritization with CMDB
intent: Rank open vulnerable items by exploitability and blast radius, not by raw CVE count.

service.description: Application service name or CI sys_id to scope the ranking to.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked vulnerabilities (default 25, hard max 100).

procedure: Join CI criticality and sn.cmdb.ci.blast_radius for the service.
Return a short ranked list. No mass-close.
sideEffects: None in the read path; no mass-close.

prompts: Rank the top 10 open vulnerabilities on the customer portal service.
Which vulnerable items on app_sap_prod should I fix first, weighted by blast radius?
Show me the open VR items on service 'Self-Service' with exploitability first.
